text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm ironing out some final concert details with Light Hello…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Hello! The lyrics are done!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What? No, no, no! That'll be a surprise for the big day!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But spoiler warning—the song's going to be amazing! So start counting down to the day you get to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's too bad, Trainer. I guess I'll just check the lyrics myself then.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you don't get to listen either!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This song is our gift to everyone who supported us, and you don't get to open your presents early.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: But I can't put it on the program if I don't know what the song's called…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you and Trainer can think of that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It'll be your present to us, after sticking with us all this time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what title you come up with!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well this is awkward. Not sure how we're supposed to name a song we don't know the lyrics to.
choice_data_list: I'm sure we can come up with something together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess so. We do have plenty of time, fortunately.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Time to think about what words we want to offer them.
